name: Sun Yaozhi
current_role: Co-actual controller of the Wanxi group (Henan Wanxi Holdings / Zhongjing Wanxi Pharmaceutical, Zhongjing Food 300908.SZ); former chairman of Wanxi Pharmaceutical
profile: Sun Yaozhi (b. 1951, Neixiang, Henan; Zhengzhou University graduate) built Wanxi Pharmaceutical in Xixia county, Nanyang, into Zhongjing Wanxi, maker of Zhongjing Liuwei Dihuang pills. He and Zhu Xincheng are the actual controllers of listed Zhongjing Food (300908.SZ); day-to-day leadership has passed to Sun Feng, chairman of Wanxi Pharma since Oct 2017.
interesting_fact: He served as a deputy to China's National People's Congress for Henan, first elected in 2008 and again in 2013 (12th NPC).
deep_cut_fact: Zhongjing Food, controlled by Sun and Zhu Xincheng, is headquartered in Xixia, billed as China's 'hometown of shiitake mushrooms'; its flagship is Zhongjing shiitake-mushroom sauce and it calls itself a partner of China's space programme.
notes: Listed as actual controller in Zhongjing Food's H1 2026 report (Aug 2026), but no recent public appearances found; alive status not directly confirmed. Not on the board; best route is Zhongjing Food IR / board secretary Wang Fei.
